description: Hello! I am a student from Peru, and I am interested in science, technology, astronomy, and environmental sciences. I can contribute skills in research, creativity, organization, and communication. Our project aims to transform images of the Earth into sounds through sonification. We are looking for team members with expertise in programming, data analysis, image processing, sound design, and software development. We are very excited to learn and create something together!
summary: We developed an interactive web platform that transforms satellite images of four different regions of the world, obtained from NASA sources, into various musical compositions. Through the use of artificial intelligence, we provide the images, environmental variables, and instrumental assignments to generate unique melodies based on the characteristics of each image. In this way, we address the challenge from a more artistic and innovative perspective, turning scientific information into an interactive auditory experience. Our project aims to promote environmental awareness and bring people closer to the changes occurring on Earth, many of which go unnoticed. It also allows users to explore and discover different environments around the world without relying solely on technical explanations or in-person visits.
details:
Functionality and Features

The platform allows users to explore four geographical regions: the Cordillera Blanca, the Amazon Rainforest, the Atacama Desert, and Antarctica. Users can view satellite images, consult the environmental variables represented, learn about the instruments assigned to each one, and listen to the corresponding musical compositions.

To generate the melodies, we use Gemini as an artificial intelligence tool. We provide it with the satellite images, environmental variables, and instrumental assignments established by the team. We also consider visual characteristics of the images, such as color, brightness, and contrast, to facilitate their interpretation during the sonification process.

The team established a correspondence between environmental variables and specific musical instruments. Based on these assignments, Gemini generates compositions whose characteristics, pitches, and accompanying elements may vary depending on the image provided.

The website also includes informational sections presenting the project's origins and history, the tools used, and other aspects of its development.

Benefits

The project offers an alternative way to explore information about the Earth by combining visual and auditory resources. It allows users to discover different regions and some of their environmental characteristics through an interactive experience, without relying solely on technical explanations or prior scientific knowledge.

Furthermore, incorporating sound as a means of exploration opens up possibilities for people with visual impairments to engage with information about different environments around the planet.

Intended Impact

We aim to promote environmental awareness and spark interest in the changes occurring on our planet, many of which often go unnoticed. We hope this experience will allow people to recognize the diversity of Earth's environments and develop greater curiosity about the environmental phenomena occurring within them.

We also propose an auditory alternative that can complement traditional ways of exploring information about the Earth and offer new opportunities for people with visual impairments to engage with this information.

Creativity and Innovation

Our proposal combines science, technology, and art to transform satellite information into musical compositions. Assigning instruments to different variables represents an artistic interpretation developed by the team, allowing data to be represented through sound.

Each instrument maintains a relationship with a specific variable, but the musical characteristics and pitch change depending on the image used. In this way, each composition offers a unique auditory interpretation of the information presented.

Factors Considered

During development, we considered the geographical and environmental diversity of the selected regions. The Cordillera Blanca, the Amazon Rainforest, the Atacama Desert, and Antarctica present different characteristics and environmental contrasts, allowing us to explore diverse environments and generate varied musical compositions.

We also considered variables such as vegetation, ocean currents, precipitation, and ice cover, as well as visual characteristics of satellite images, including color, brightness, and contrast. Finally, we sought to maintain a consistent relationship between environmental variables and their assigned musical instruments.

Tools and Technologies

The project uses satellite images obtained from NASA sources and Gemini as an artificial intelligence tool for generating musical compositions. Visual Studio Code was used as the development environment for the web platform. Python was also explored during the initial stages of development, although it was not included in the final prototype. These tools and resources contributed to the development of the platform and its interactive features.
